description: This file implements functionality to scalarize vector and matrix constructor arguments in shader code, transforming constructor arguments to avoid driver bugs by breaking down complex vector/matrix arguments into simpler components. It defines a traverser class that modifies the abstract syntax tree (AST) of shader code.

classes.name: ScalarizeArgsTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that identifies and scalarizes vector and matrix constructor arguments in shader code.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes in the AST to identify scalarizable vector/matrix constructors.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Visits block nodes to process contained statements.

methods.name: scalarizeArgs
methods.description: Performs the scalarization of constructor arguments, replacing complex arguments with simpler, scalar components.

methods.name: createTempVariable
methods.description: Creates temporary variables to hold intermediate constructor argument values.
